model_annotation: This chart illustrates the composition of incidents involving Chinese characters in written communication, categorized by incident type. The vertical axis represents the number of incidents, labeled in Chinese characters, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7000, incrementing by 1000 units. Each incident type is represented by a stacked bar, with segments indicating the proportion of incidents attributed to different causes, including “总上报” (Total Reported), “网络言论” (Online Speech), “其他” (Other), “商业广告” (Commercial Advertisement), “不良信息” (Harmful Information), “色情” (Pornography), “欺诈” (Fraud), “侵权” (Infringement), “泄露个人隐私” (Personal Privacy Disclosure), “寻衅滋事” (Provocation), and “谣言” (Rumors). The “特使文字” bar has a total height of approximately 1865, with “网络言论” at around 1116 and “泄露个人隐私” at around 14. The “网络小说” bar reaches approximately 6763, with “网络言论” at around 4881 and “泄露个人隐私” at around 46. The “废语” bar has a total height of approximately 738, with “网络言论” at around 555 and “泄露个人隐私” at around 12.
